# Org Tree Builder

## Summary
`buildOrgTree(items, parentIdOf)` turns a flat list plus a parent edge into a forest of `OrgNode { item, children }`. Items whose parent is missing become roots, and a cycle is broken rather than looped, so a bad edge in the data cannot hang a render. The Tree component re-exports it as `buildTree` and renders `OrgNode` as its node shape.

## Usage
```ts
import { buildOrgTree } from '@cardstack/catalog/utils/org-tree';

let roots = buildOrgTree(employees, (e) => e.manager?.id);
```

## Non-goals
No rendering, no sorting of siblings (input order is kept), no persistence of the tree.
